issue_request: FHIR-37668 is a Published/Persuasive technical correction asking that the R4B explanation page use "pandemic" instead of the misspelling "pendemic".
initial_application: No Jira-tagged source commit for FHIR-37668 was found. Historical R4B-only source history shows source/r4b-explanation.html was added in commit 670aa69262 with the misspelling, and the final R4B release source commit 6e09741dfd still contained "Covid pendemic".
additional_context: The current branch does not contain source/r4b-explanation.html, the historical R4B documentation commits are not ancestors of the current build branch, and current source has no "pendemic" occurrence. The current history page only links to the archived R4B explanation page, which still contains the typo on hl7.org.
reconciliation: No source change was made because adding or editing a current-branch source/r4b-explanation.html file would create an out-of-build artifact and would not correct the archived published R4B page.
